field_descriptions.available_language: A language someone may use with or at the item, service or place. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[inLanguage]].
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.processing_time: Estimated processing time for the service using this channel.
field_descriptions.provides_service: The service provided by this channel.
field_descriptions.service_location: The location (e.g. civic structure, local business, etc.) where a person can go to access the service.
field_descriptions.service_phone: The phone number to use to access the service.
field_descriptions.service_postal_address: The address for accessing the service by mail.
field_descriptions.service_sms_number: The number to access the service by text message.
field_descriptions.service_url: The website to access the service.
